items.title: McKesson (MCK) Plans Medical Surgical Spin Off With $1.25 Billion Backing
items.summary: McKesson (NYSE:MCK) plans to spin off its Medical-Surgical Solutions segment into a separate company, according to a recent announcement. Apollo affiliated investors agreed to invest US$1.25b in the new Medical-Surgical Solutions entity as part of the separation plan. The transaction is structured as a spin off, which would separate McKesson's medical-surgical distribution activities from its remaining operations.
